description:
A false-colour satellite image displaying land cover/land use classes, delineated by yellow polygon boundaries and labelled with numeric codes, over a coastal area. Water bodies appear dark blue or black, while vegetated land shows in shades of red, indicating high infrared reflectance. Areas of human development or bare ground appear as lighter specks within the red vegetation.

Specific land cover classes identified by code are:
*   `1110`: Labelled in three yellow-outlined polygons on a grey background, representing "Continuous Urban Fabric". These areas contain numerous small white/light grey features likely indicating buildings or impervious surfaces.
*   `4212`: Labelled in two yellow-outlined polygons on an orange background, located directly adjacent to the dark water bodies, suggesting a coastal or water-related land cover type.
*   `3110`: Labelled in the bottom right corner on a brown/orange background, without a polygon outline, situated within a predominantly red, vegetated area, likely representing "Broad-leaved forest".

No scale bar, compass, or explicit geographic location are visible.
